INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Romantic light dazzling, SEBASTIAN HAWTHORNE (Male, 28) dressed in a crisp shirt and slacks pins LYDIA ROWAN(Female, 25), wearing a sexy lingerie, under him in bed. They kiss fiercely, hungry for each other. LYDIA (V.O.)My husband and I have been married for 7 years. Who would've thought, he would throw me in his brother's bed for a stupid joke I made.

LYDIA (O.S.)(narrating)I was the youngest Grand Slam champion in the history of LPGA. At the peak of my career, I retired. I married Vincent and became his agent and his coach. For seven years, I helped him boost his career while taking care of him at home as a housewife. A month ago, he finally won his championship. He promised we'd have a real wedding. But two days before the ceremony… somebody shoved me down the stairs in our hotel.
- A golf course. Lydia swings, perfect hole-in-one. The crowd cheers. She jumps in excitement and hugs VINCENT HAWTHORNE(MALE, 25), still in his tournament uniform. - Lydia laughs, holding a trophy.

MATCH CUT TO the same image on a TV NEWS BROADCAST. ON-SCREEN HEADLINE: “YOUNGEST GRAND SLAM CHAMPION ANNOUNCES RETIREMENT.” Camera pans to a living room— Vincent kneels on one knee, proposing. Lydia cries and nods. They embrace. - At home: Lydia cooks, cleans.

- Final tournament, Vincent swings. The crowd goes wild. Lydia’s eyes fill with tears as Vincent is swarmed by reporters. - A hotel staircase. Lydia, in her wedding dress, descends carefully. A HAND suddenly SHOVES her from behind. She tumbles down the stairs, blood at her temple. Her vision blurs. Through the haze, a woman in a RED DRESS. End Montage

INT. HOTEL ROOM – DAY

Lydia lies in bed, a white bandage wrapped around her forehead. Her eyes flutter open. Surrounding her: Vincent. Sebastian. ZOE ADAMS (25), wearing a glamorous long dress. DOCTOR. All of them look tense. Worried. Vincent immediately pulls Lydia into his arms. VINCENTYou’re awake. Thank God. You scared me to death. Lydia’s gaze drifts to Sebastian. LYDIA (V.O.)(confused)Sebastian…Wasn’t he the one who hated me the most? Why would he drop everything at the company just to come to my wedding? VINCENT(panicked)Lydia? Seeing his anxious expression, Lydia lowers her head, stifling a smile. Then she looks up, suddenly alert. She pushes him away. LYDIAWho are you? Everyone freezes. Vincent stiffens, then grabs the doctor in a panic.

VINCENTWhat’s going on? DOCTORShe suffered severe head trauma. Memory loss is… possible. Lydia presses her lips together, holding back laughter. LYDIAWhy do you care so much about me? Who are you? Vincent’s eyes dart. Thinking fast. He suddenly pulls Sebastian forward. VINCENTI’m your brother-in-law. And this is your husband. The smile vanishes from Lydia’s face. Zoe snaps her head toward Vincent, stunned. Sebastian turns sharply, staring at Vincent in disbelief— then slowly looks back at Lydia, his brow furrowing. Episode 2
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Vincent hugs Zoe in his arms. VINCENTIt's my wedding with your best friend Zoe tomorrow. You are here for our wedding. Sebastian frowns at Vincent, and looks at Lydia, worried. Lydia holds back her tears by forcem, her lips shaking. Zoe's eyes widen, her jaw drops upon hearing Vicent's words. She braces Vincent and looks at Lydia while pressing down her excitement. ZOE(delightful)That's right. You heard him. LYDIA (V.O.)(desperate)So you've been cheating on me all this time, with my best friend!(MORE)

LYDIA (V.O.) (CONT'D)Vincent Hawthorne, I gave up my career at my peak for you, yet you cheated on me! Lydia takes a deep breath, holding herself together, and lifts the blanket. LYDIABut why am I in wedding dress. Vincent stays silent. Zoe lunges at Lydia and rips off the veil from her head. Sebastian frowns and steps forward. ZOE(condescending)You never had a proper wedding with Sebastian and you are jealous of me. So I let you borrowed them to feel what it's like to be the bride. Zoe reaches for Lydia's wedding ring. ZOE (CONT'D)And my ring, my gown. Give them back. Sebastian grabs her wrist and pulls her hand away from Lydia. SEBASTIAN(cold)Get off her. Zoe falls back in Vincent's arms, as if she was bullied. Sebastian picks up Lydia's hand and inspects it, worried. Lydia is confused. Lydia's hands clinch in fists. Her eyes are pink, body shaking from pressing down her anger. She lifts her hand. LYDIACome get it yourself. Zoe lets out a triumphant laugh. Vincent steps forward and takes off the ring without hesitation.
INT. LYDIA'S HOUSE - DAY
Vincent puts on the ring for Lydia, who is drowning in joyful tears. VINCENT(tender, swearing)Lydia, I swear on my life, I will never betray you.
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

The ring is taken off, Lydia's eyes lingering on it while Vincent puts it on for Zoe, who then flashes it in the air, triumphant. LYDIA (V.O.)Vincent, you broke your promise. ZOE(taunting)And the dress? LYDIA(forcing calm)I will go change in the bathroom now. Sebastian frowns upon watching Lydia getting out of bed and walking into the bathroom. He turns and gazes at Zoe, cold and furious. SEBASTIAN(to Lydia)You, out. Zoe frightened under Sebastian's gaze, she looks at Vincent, seeking refuge. Vincent waves his hand, gestures for her to leave. Zoe leaves the room, unwillingly. SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)(irritated)If you want a divorce, just get one. What the fuck was that all about?

Lydia eavesdrops on the conversation behind the door. Her effort to press down anger is explicit. Episode 3

VINCENTNo, I don't want a divorce. It's just that, we've been together for 7 years. Honestly, it gets boring and I just want to have some fun. Come on bro, help me with this. Just play along. Sebastian looks at the bathroom door, and takes a seat with grace. SEBASTIANAnd you are not afraid that we might become a real thing? VINCENTNah, get out of here. You are my brother and she's your sister-in-law. And don't you have a grudge against her since always? Sebastian smiles, unreadable. SEBASTIANFine, I will help you. VINCENT(excited)Thanks Seb, I knew I could count on you!
INT. BATHROOM - DAY
Lydia leans at the door, weeping quietly, her whole body is shaking. LYDIA (V.O.)Seven years of my devotion and sacrifice, and this is what I get in return. If you want to play, then let's play.
LYDIA(shouting)Babe, come help me with this zip.

SEBASTIAN/VINCENT(simultaneously)Coming! Sebastian and Vincent looks at each other in shock and then turn to the bathroom door. Episode 4

Vincent steps up spontaneously, but Sebastian stops him with one hand. SEBASTIAN(lowering voice)I am her husband now, remember?(tender, to Lydia)Coming, babe. Sebastian walks toward the bathroom. VINCENT(Shocked)He's already in character now...
INT. HOTEL ROOM - BATHROOM - DAY

Sebastian enters the bathroom, approaches Lydia from behind. Lydia stands in front of a mirror. She is struggling to reach the zip on her back, palm up. She watches Sebastian approaching from behind in the mirror, her breath intensifies. Sebastian slides his hand over Lydia's hand, and unzips her dress slowly, revealing her bare back. Lydia catches the falling dress, clutching it to her chest. Sebastian raises his eyes, locking with Lydia's in the mirror. His breath accelerates. His hand is spontaneously drawn to Lydia's bare back by temptation. Lydia leans back, meeting his hand with her back. Her body swings slightly, as if she's feeling his hand with her back.

LYDIAHelp me undress, babe. Sebastian's body jerks, as if hit by a bolt. He slowly slides his one hand into the the dress, and pulls the dress down with the other hand. Lydia braces her arms around her breast, covering it. She breathes nervously. Sebastian steps closer and brings his chest at her back. He picks up the strap dress from the sink table. SEBASTIANWant me to put it on for you? LYDIAMh-hm, put me through it. Sebastian's lips crack from surprise, his eye meets with Lydia's in the mirror, seducing him. Episode 5

Sebastian squats beside Lydia. He snatches her ankle, lifting her one foot. Lydia loses balance. She tilts forward and bends over toward the mirror, supporting herself with one arm on the sink. SEBASTIANDo you want me to fuck you right here in front of the mirror? Want to see yourself getting fucked in the mirror? LYDIA(blushing, cute)Hey! That's not what I meant! SEBASTIANShhh- Sebastian puts Lydia's legs through the dress. His hands slide up on her lap, slowly approaching between her legs, all covered under the dress. Sebastian reads Lydia's reaction in the mirror. Lydia is losing it, moaning. Just as she is enjoying it the most, Sebastian suddenly stops.

He takes his hands out from the dress and slides them up, putting the dress all the way on for her. Disappointment flickers on Lydia's face. LYDIA (V.O.)He really hates me. Should've guessed it. I'm almost naked, but he's not turned on at all.

Sebastian plays minigolf dressed in polo shirt. Behind his back, stands four men in black. Vincent stands before sebastian with Lydia behind him, holding hands. Sebastian frowns as he sees them holding hands. LYDIA (V.O.)So this is the CEO of T.K. Sports. The legends are true, he is a rigid man. SEBASTIAN(unwillingly, firm)I don't approve this marriage.

Vincent leans at the door, eavesdropping. Lydia's moaning passes on off scene. VINCENT(triggered)What's taking so long!

Just before Vincent lunges, the door swings open. Lydia and Sebastian are standing side by side. Vincent stares at them, checking. VINCENT (CONT'D)(anxious)Did you guys... do anything in there? LYDIA(smiling)What is it to you? It's none of your business. We are a married couple. Sebastian lowers his head and locks eyes with Lydia. Vincent is triggered but unable to justify his anger. Zoe walks in and cuddles Vincent. ZOE(delightful)Babe, our party is about to start. Let's go.(poking fun)Give your brother and his wife some privacy. Zoe drags Vincent out. LYDIA(to sebastian)Let's join the party.

Lydia enters with sebastian. The crowd is drinking and dancing in dazzling light and loud music. Zoe tangles Vincent with her legs on his hip. The crowd cheers, while Sebastian frowns at the scene. Lydia's eyes turn red, fist clenches. Episode 7
Lydia sprains her wrist as she spins the golf club. Vincent picks up her hand and rubs her wrist carefully with a towel, kissing it. LYDIAI'm ok. Wait-
Vincent liftes her up. Holding her in his arms.
INT. VIP LOUNGE - NIGHT

LYDIA (V.O.)I thought he would only do those things with me. Turns out he's just fooling around. Sebastian steps forward and protects Lydia from the view. SEBASTIANYou are not fully recovered yet. I think some rest will do you good. Come, let's get you to bed.
LYDIA (V.O.)The losers run, not me. I don't run away - from every game and every crisis since I was a kid. And I will not run from Vincent and his little games.

Lydia smiles and raises his head, suddenly grabs Sebastian's tie and pulls him close. Her gaze lingers on his lips, seductive. LYDIA(seductive)No, I'm fine, babe. Lydia chuckles, her hand wanders on Sebastian's chest. She picks up a wine glass and drinks it while remaining her eyes locked with Sebastian's. Sebastian's throat bobs. Lydia swirls the glass and brings her lip closer to Sebastian. LYDIA (CONT'D)This wine is quite something. Seriously. Sebastian lowers his eyes, breathes intensely. As he watches Lydia taking another sip, he can't help but to kiss Lydia wildly. He holds Lydia's head with his hand from behind, sliding down to her neck and ear. Sebastian sucks wine from Lydia's mouth, some of which leaks and drips down from her mouth. He wipes it with his thumb, then puts his thumb in Lydia's mouth. SEBASTIANClean it up for me. Lydia sucks Sebastian's finger while gazing at him. SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)What does it taste like? Lydia releases Sebastian's finger. She dips some wine with her index finger and brings it to Sebastian's mouth. LYDIASee for yourself. Sebastian catches and sucks her finger. SEBASTIANNot so bad. Quite sweet actually. LYDIA(smiling)The wine or the girl? SEBASTIANYou, of course.

They resume kissing, more devoted and fierce this time, French. Vincent is distracted from his kiss with Zoe by the crowd cheering for Sebastian and Lydia. He opens his eyes and sees them kissing. Shocked and irritated, he shoves away Zoe. Episode 8

Vincent lunges at Sebastian and Lydia, but Zoe stops him. ZOE(upset)Hey, you are my husband now. Stick to your role. Vincent clenches his fists, shuts his eyes by force, struggling in pain. He brushes off Zoe's arms and lunges at Lydia, separates Sebastian and her. LYDIA(innocent, confused)What are you doing? Vincent takes a deep breath and barely contains his jealousy with force. His eyes are locked with Sebastian, a deadly gaze. VINCENT(teeth gritting)A word, Seb. Outside, now! Lydia looks at Sebastian. Sebastian smiles and nods. LYDIANo, I will go fix my make-up and leave you gents to the matter.

Lydia turns away, a victorious smile on her face. She walks out the scene. Vincent steps closer to Sebastian, anger and jealousy errupting. VINCENT(furious)Lydia, is, my wife. Don't forget that, Seb. You are crossing the line. SEBASTIAN(cold)I'm surprised you still remember that. Didn't seem to bother you when you stick your tongue in her best friend's mouth. What happens when she recovers her memory and wants a divorce? VINCENT(confident)No she wouldn't. She gave up her career and married me, and hid that from the media for me for 7 years. I am the love of her life. She will always come back to me like a dog when I whistle. She, is, mine! Sebastian's face remains cold and dark.

Lydia leans back against the wall. She is disgusted by Vincent. LYDIA (V.O.)Whatever makes you think that I can't live without you. You are so wrong. I will divorce you and you will suffer in remorse for the rest of your life. Sebastian enters the hallway and steps toward Lydia. Lydia opens her mouth about to talk, but Sebastian pins her against the wall. SEBASTIANLet's pick up where we left at. I can't wait to fuck your brains out.
